arabic_locator.text: وَقِيلَ: ﴿وَانْحَرْ﴾ أَيْ: اسْتَقْبِلْ بِنَحْرِكَ الْقِبْلَةَ. ذَكَرَ هَذِهِ الْأَقْوَالَ الثَّلَاثَةَ ابْنُ جَرِيرٍ.

semantic_units.statement_en: Ibn Kathir records an unnamed interpretation of wanhar as facing the qibla with one's upper chest.
semantic_units.scope: Qila leaves the originator unspecified; Ibn Jarir must not be substituted as originator.

semantic_units.statement_en: Ibn Kathir states that Ibn Jarir mentioned these three interpretations.
semantic_units.scope: These three refers to the preceding hand-placement, opening-prayer hand-raising and facing-qibla interpretations; it does not establish that Ibn Jarir endorsed or originated all three.

role_distinctions.Ibn_Jarir: Named earlier reporter who mentioned three views

fidelity_notes: استقبل بنحرك القبلة: face the qibla with your upper chest; preserve anatomical wording rather than changing it to sacrifice.
ذكر is mentioned/recorded; endorsement and origination are not stated.
English wording is analytical paraphrase of Arabic, not a quotation from the abridged English witness.
Do not transfer Ali-specific la yasihh criticism or later authorial preference into this anonymous attribution.
disagreement: Facing-qibla interpretation differs from sacrificial slaughter preferred later; authorial preference remains separately located.
remaining: Resolve anonymous physical voice representation without inventing group or named originator
Draft required evidence/link fields and negative validator preserving all three exact clauses
